set.body: 2026-10-07 prospective quality campaign finds MNI6 Schaefer1000 -> fsLR32k disagrees with published same-revision CBIG labels at 35.16% L / 37.26% R of cortical vertices. Source keys 214 (650 voxels -> 3 fsaverage vertices -> 0 fsLR), 710 (417 -> 1 -> 0), and 903 (98 -> 67 -> 0) disappear. Key903 is also absent from the published fsLR reference. Right-hemisphere outputs contain 2-3 left-hemisphere-labelled vertices. No-label-loss campaign criterion fails. All 12 native surface label cases agree exactly with WB BARYCENTRIC, so computational parity does not fix population-projection information loss. Investigate richer sampling/coverage and user-visible diagnostics; preserve dependent-reference distinction and original release evidence. Parent bd-01M4AYFGCW290FC4ZGNKZE4PGE. Evidence in data-raw/transform-quality-v1.
set.title: Qualify fine-parcel projection and expose label loss
